title: Refund Posting Lag on Domain Registrations Refunds: Compensation Basis
content:
# Compensation basis by posting lag

The compensation basis of the late-posting goodwill depends on how long the posting lagged, the calendar days from the refund line's date to the date of the account's refund credit entry for the refunded charge's order number: where those days are 10 or more, the basis is $3.00 for each started week of those days; where they are 5 or more but fewer than 10, the basis is $4.00 flat; where they are fewer than 5, the basis is 0.2 (20 percent) of the refund credit posted.

A started week counts in full and is seven days: 10 lag days are two started weeks, 29 lag days are five.

| Days the posting lagged | Basis (hypothetical refund credit of $31.80) |
|---|---|
| 4 | 20 percent of $31.80, $6.36 |
| 5 | $4.00 |
| 9 | $4.00 |
| 10 | $6.00 |
| 29 | $15.00 |

*Applies to: Harborline Customer Accounts, for domain refunds on Domain Registrations returned to account credit*
